decisions.reason: The existing MODIFY captures the AXP2101 source and battery path but omits the explicitly specified 2A rating of DCDC1.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
3.3V rail (AXP2101 DCDC1, 2A) — primary power source when power board is connected:
\- ESP32-S3 module
\- INA219
\- All I2C sensors (SCD41, BME280, ENS160) via sensor board
\- I2C display
\- TTP223, AM312 PIR

5V rail (MT3608 boost, 500mA) — controlled by ESP32 GPIO3:
\- SPS30 particulate sensor
\- ZE08-CH2O formaldehyde sensor
\- SK6812 LEDs (if wired to 5V — depends on version)

3.3V rail (ME6211A LDO, 1A) — only active when USB-C on main board connected WITHOUT power board:
\- Same 3.3V rail as above — Schottky diode OR-ing means whichever source is present wins. Used for standalone programming.

Battery (3.7–4.2V) — feeds AXP2101 which then feeds everything above.

Simple rule: in normal operation AXP2101 powers everything. The LDO only kicks in when programming without the power board connected.

value_updates.normal_operation_power_path: The battery feeds AXP2101, which powers the system in normal operation

decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already captures the newly specified 500mA rating and affected 5V loads; no additional state change is required.
The existing same-message MODIFY captures the named I2C modules and their 3.3V sensor-board supply; upstream source selection does not alter their module interfaces.
The existing same-message MODIFY captures the SK6812 family, while the conditional 5V wording does not establish a definite LED-board supply change.
Changing the source of the shared 3.3V rail does not change the I2C pull-up, speed, cable-length, or series-resistor requirements.
The source-selection clarification leaves the established interboard connector types and pinouts unchanged.
The electrical power-source clarification does not alter battery-connector placement, orientation, spacing, or mechanical clearance.
The rail and source-selection decision does not change the power board's dimensions, mounting holes, enclosure fit, or USB-C placement.
The battery voltage and AXP2101 feed description does not resolve or change the battery connector's pinout, series, pitch, or mounting type.
Naming the ME6211A in this message does not change the general component sourceability policy or establish a sourcing outcome.
The power-rail decision does not affect KiCad library portability or footprint resolution.
The source message does not change BOM completeness, part-number requirements, or the recorded R6 assembly settings.
